title: Embed & Rerank: Backfill-first Variant Swap Policy with Adaptive Traffic Prioritization
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: New embedding model variants for the reranking endpoint are arriving faster than we can safely swap globally without impacting semantic stability, latency SLOs, and tenant-specific costs. We need a repeatable policy that prioritizes correctness for high-impact tenants, minimizes end-to-end latency regressions, and supports partial backfill of vector indexes and reranker caches.

Goal: Define and implement a backfill-first variant-swap playbook that: (1) performs staged per-tenant index backfills, (2) uses adaptive traffic prioritization based on semantic drift and cost delta, (3) supports quantized-variant fallbacks for latency-sensitive traffic, and (4) exposes clear telemetry + automated rollback triggers for the Console and alerts.

Scope: This ticket covers the policy, orchestration tasks, new telemetry signals, integration tests, and a small-serving-side agent to coordinate per-tenant backfills and traffic shaping. It does NOT include the massive cross-tenant backfill execution engine (that will be a follow-on).
acceptance_criteria: Policy doc published in Confluence describing tenant prioritization, cost tiebreakers, and safety fences
Service-side coordinator prototype that can: mark tenants as "ready_for_swap", schedule per-tenant backfill jobs, and update routing weights atomically
Console surface for swap status per-tenant (pending, backfilling, routing-adjusted, complete)
Three automated telemetry-driven rollback triggers implemented: semantic-delta > threshold, 95p latency > 2x baseline, cost-per-request delta > configured percent
End-to-end integration tests covering canary -> staged -> full swap paths with synthetic semantic regression checks
Documentation and runbook for SRE/Oncall with post-mortem template for swap incidents
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Design + Review: finalize gating criteria and API shape for coordinator (2 weeks)
Phase 1 - Prototype: minimal coordinator service + Console stub; smoke test on internal tenant (1 week)
Phase 2 - Canary: run full backfill + swap for non-critical tenant cohorts (10% traffic) with close telemetry (2 weeks)
Phase 3 - Staged Expansion: expand prioritized tenants by SLA and drift score with automated cost tiebreaker (incremental 20% steps)
Phase 4 - Global Swap: complete remaining tenants if no regression signals; schedule cross-tenant backfill for low-priority tenants during off-peak
telemetry_signals: semantic_similarity_delta_per_tenant (baseline vs new model) - daily and rolling-1h
tokens_per_response and tokens_per_request change after swap
failed_rerank_matches and fallbacks_count (how often we fallback to previous variant)
rollback_plan: Immediate atomic routing flip to previous variant if any rollback trigger fires
If a backfill job causes resource saturation, pause backfills and reduce traffic to impacted tenant cohorts
Graceful rollback with degradation path: prefer quantized low-latency variant if regression is latency-only
Run automated suite to validate recovery and schedule post-incident follow-up within 48 hours
testing_plan: Unit tests for coordinator state machine (pending -> backfilling -> routing-adjusted -> complete)
Integration test harness that runs synthetic semantic checks against eval prompt set and asserts delta thresholds
Load test that simulates per-tenant backfill resource consumption and verifies autoscaling responds without increased 95p latency
Chaos test: simulate a mid-backfill instance failure and confirm coordinator retries/backoff and no incorrect routing flips
Canary-runbook checklist to be executed by oncall during each early-stage swap
risks_mitigations: Risk: Backfill saturates GPU capacity -> Mitigation: backfill rate limiter + resource-aware scheduler (pause when node CPU/GPU > threshold)
Risk: Semantic regression for high-value tenant -> Mitigation: per-tenant holdout traffic to validate quality and manual gate before full expansion
Risk: Cost spike for tenant due to larger token sizes -> Mitigation: cost tiebreaker that defers swap if cost delta > configured percent
Risk: Index inconsistency during swap -> Mitigation: two-phase commit for routing weight change after backfill checkpoint and KV cache priming
